method: Built-in ImageGen, one image per distinct shape; parallel requests
export: Proportional Lanczos downsampling to at most 540x810, then lossless RGBA PNG encoding. No geometry, color, label or background edits.
motion: Existing native-driven expanded My Shelf motion; Reduce Motion and background pause retained.

assets.refinementPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Polish this original label-free bottle illustration for the Bourbon Signal catalog. Preserve EXACT silhouette, dimensions, centered position, neck/cork/wood stopper geometry, glass heel, warm amber color, glass side reflections and TRUE transparent alpha background. Change ONLY the two anomalous dark horizontal lines across the front amber glass: remove the extra thin dark stripe slightly BELOW the shoulders, and remove the short dark horizontal stripe near the LOWER front body. These are ghost label edges, not physical seams. Smooth uninterrupted front glass and physically plausible amber whiskey should fill those two areas. Keep ONE physically plausible liquid meniscus at the shoulder liquid level, and keep natural glass heel refraction. Absolutely no labels, words, logos or new decoration. Do not alter the framing, shape or exterior alpha.
